cards.title: Two quantities
items: Returned: the height (nodes on the longest downward path)
Recorded: l + r, the edges of the longest path bending at this node
The parent needs only the height; the answer lives in the running best

cards.title: Cost
items: Each node is visited exactly once: O(n)
Call stack as deep as the tree is tall: O(h)
A tree skewed into a chain: h = n

cards.title: Common traps
items: Returning l + r to the parent: the parent cannot extend a path that already bends
Checking only paths through the root: wrong when the longest path sits inside one subtree
Counting nodes instead of edges: off by one
